# Showcase Elf — elf — 560 points

*v1999.12.0*

## Elf Infantry (2×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 4x Elf Infantry
- Type: Bio, Infantry, Walking
- Points: 24
- Shaken: slow [-, -, flee] / Can't use weapons

- **To Hit**: Take Cover[Still][-2]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 0-6 | Kill 1 model |
| 7-8 | Kill 1 model, Psychic damage[d6] |
| 9+ | Unit destroyed |
- If one model is killed remove half of the +1 future damage tokens and if killed by bleeding/poison, remove that bleeding/poison token

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 4+ | shaken |


### Elf Infantry

- Equipment: 1x Rifle
- Assault: strength 1/1/1/1 (5+), deflection 0/0/0/0 (5+), damage d6-2, AP 2


- **Cunning Assault**: [2]

#### Rifle

- Range: 5, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6-2, AP 2

## Armored Oliphant Riders (4×)

- Size: Large
- Models: 1x Oliphant, 4x Oliphant Crew
- Type: Bio, Walking
- Armor: 8/6/4/3
- Points: 56
- Shaken: slow [-, -, Chs] / Can't use weapons

- **Resistance**: Poison[2]
- **Fire Order**: The Crew fires a bow or Throw grenade, while Fire(g), aim(g) and load(g) orders are for the gatling guns only. Only the gatling gun needs to be reloaded

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 2-6 | Bleed[8] |
| 7 | As below, d6 Psychic damage |
| 8+ | Unit killed |
- bleeding does not cause more bleeding

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 6+ | shaken |


### Oliphant

- Equipment: 1x Oliphant Gatling Guns
- Assault: strength 9/6/6/2 (5+), deflection 6/2/2/2 (5+), damage d6, AP 4



#### Oliphant Gatling Guns

- Range: 2, angle False/True/True/False, damage d6-1, AP 3
- **Multiple Shots**: May fire at both sides with each fire order. Fire once at each enemy model within long range and within allowed angles
- **Focus Fire**: When using aim, roll 6 dice at same unit.
- **Area**: If not using aim, area[4+] at point blank range and area[6+] at all hexes within normal and long range and within all allowed angles, but avoids hexes with friendly units.


### Oliphant Crew

- Equipment: 1x Elf Bow, 1x Crew Hand Grenade
- Assault: strength 0/0/0/0 (5+), deflection 0/0/0/0 (5+), damage -, AP N/A

- **To Hit**: Ignore Fast Penalty. Applies to the target's penalty as well, and to flying as well as fast; Bad at Long Range. Doubles the long-range penalty; Enhanced Accuracy


#### Elf Bow

- Range: 2, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6-2, AP 0
- **Range**: +1 range if you are flying
- **Ammo**: Always treated as loaded

#### Crew Hand Grenade

- Range: 1, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6, AP 5
- **Area**: [4+]
- **Range**: Target any hex within normal range
- **Ammo**: Always loaded
- **Order**: Used with Throw order

## E34 (2×)

- Size: Large
- Models: 1x E34
- Type: Bio Crew, Mechanical, Vehicle, Tracked
- Armor: 10/9/9/8
- Points: 144
- Shaken: still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

- **Fire Order**: Double barreled: May load up to 2 ammo, and fire them one at a time
- **Side Weapon**: Twin Rifle fires in the same direction as the Main Tank Gun, and is always treated as loaded as long as the Main Tank gun is loaded

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-3 | +1 on future damage |
| 4 | as below, shaken |
| 5-8 | as below, Critical Damage |
| 9+ | Destroyed |

**Damage Table: Critical**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1 | Cannot move |
| 2 | -1 to hit, +1 to be hit(ranged and assault) |
| 3 | Cannot Rotate |
| 4 | +3 on future damage |
| 5 | Stuck turret: firing angle is now only forward |
| 6 | Unit is set on Fire |

**Damage Table: Crew**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 4-5 | Crippled Crew, if already shaken double initial Crew damage |
| 6-7 | as 4-5, shaken |
| 8-11 | as 6-7, +3 to future Crew damage |
| 12+ | Unit destroyed |


### E34

- Equipment: 1x Main Tank Gun, 1x Twin Rifle
- Assault: strength 4/3/3/2 (5+), deflection 2/0/0/0 (5+), damage d6-1, AP 3



#### Main Tank Gun

- Range: 4, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6 (+3 if penetrating all armor), AP 8

#### Twin Rifle

- Range: 5, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6 -2, AP 2
- **Multiple Shots**: Fires two times at same unit per shot.
